name: a_death_recoils
feel: manga page opens in black and white; Death comes, then recoils; the sniper trembles. Voice steady, declamatory

name: b_the_chase
feel: manga action: the hero follows Death through palaces and huts; the gazelle hunts the wolf (inverted world). Faster panels, speed lines

name: c_wonders
feel: the voice peaks (loudest 18-23 s): wonders of stories, life that shrinks as it grows, joys flipped into griefs. Still black and white, building pressure

name: d_ya_mawt
feel: COLOUR BURST on «يا موت»: the hero tears out of the panels and confronts Death; the row of the dead; come and give me my share

name: e_inverted_world
feel: the monkey dances with the crying boy's bread; the monkey is free, the boy is in the (Blender) cage

name: f_fleeing
feel: Death runs from the hero although it took everyone; it is dear for him in the season of cheap death

name: g_outro
feel: 17 s of instrumental pad, no beat (on_grid 0.0): the anime finale. Transformation, the cage breaks, Death flees into the sunrise, the kite flies again; then the title card
